title: Token Flow Sankey and CSV Export — Pricing Tiling Patterns
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: design an interactive token-level flow visualization (Sankey) that lets customers trace token consumption across request pipelines (prompt tokens, model response tokens, reranking, post-processing) and export granular per-token line items as CSV for billing reconciliation and custom analysis. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma prototype (desktop & narrow screen), CSV export schema, interaction spec for drilldowns, accessibility notes, and a small UI pattern library for pricing tiling (SKU + tier overlays). The Sankey should support grouping by route, model, and tag, color-coded by pricing tier, and allow toggling of cost normalization and discounts. Exports must preserve attribution keys (request_id, route, model_version, prompt_id, token_index, role, token_text, token_units, unit_price, line_item_cost). Design considerations: performance at tens of thousands of tokens (lazy aggregation, sampling preview), clear affordances for time-window controls, CSV pagination hints, and privacy controls to sanitize PII in token_text. This ticket covers concept validation, engineering sync, and a first pass prototype for a design review with PM and Eng.
